title_zh: 核对无障碍入口并分配活动接待工作

scenario.goal_zh: 确认入口与电梯位置并分配接待工作

context_zh: 社区活动的两名志愿者核对入口、电梯与不同访客的接待需求。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Some disabled visitors asked whether the side entrance is open today.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: It is. It leads straight into this corridor, and the lift is on the right.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Good. An elderly couple also asked if there's somewhere to sit before the doors open.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: There are chairs near the lift. I'll check that nobody has left boxes in front of them.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: We should ask people what help they want rather than assume. Not every disability is visible.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Agreed. Would you welcome people at the side entrance while I cover the main doors?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Yes. I'll point out the lift and the chairs, and ask before offering any physical help.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: I'll keep my phone on so you can call me if you need another volunteer.

targets.sense_zh: 影响活动或参与的身体或精神功能障碍
